trustBannerTitle: SSH mode · review evidence may be incomplete:
trustBanner: In remote mode, the local app usually keeps session metadata only; full diffs / file snapshots may not be returned. Combine remote git status when reviewing — do not treat local details as complete evidence.
trustBannerHint: See the limited-capture notice in the session changes dialog; upgrading the remote Codex SDK (ssh_full) improves capture.
artifactLimitedBody: During remote execution, the local database usually keeps conversation metadata only; full file snapshots may be unavailable. You can still view logs, continue the session, or inspect git status on the remote host. Upgrade the remote Codex SDK (ssh_full) or review on the remote machine for fuller details.
artifactLimitedWhy: This is SSH remote execution. The local database mainly stores session metadata; full file diffs / snapshots may not sync back.
artifactLimitedCan: View session logs, continue the conversation, and check git status / diff on the remote host.
artifactLimitedHow: Upgrade the remote Codex SDK to enable ssh_full capture when available, or review changes directly on the remote machine.
artifactLimited: Remote session change details are limited; review evidence may be incomplete.
